lead.headline: Jefferson still unpriced; Addison is now the cover
lead.deck: Jefferson didn't practise Wednesday and ESPN still says 18.7. You added Addison overnight, so a Sunday inactive is a bench swap.
lead.body: Justin Jefferson remains the problem. He did not practise Wednesday on the sprained right ankle, and Kevin O'Connell would say only that he is 'feeling a little bit better, but not in any place right now to talk about what that means for the weekend.' ESPN still projects him at 18.7, so the absence is not priced. Overnight you added Jordan Addison for Denzel Boston, which simplifies the plan: if Jefferson is inactive at 12:35 Sunday, Addison takes his slot. The lineup tool would pick Jalen Coker, but Coker also missed Wednesday and is not confirmed active until 16:50, after Addison has locked. Jaylen Warren opens the week tonight at Cleveland with Rico Dowdle ruled out; there is nothing to set. Thursday's practice report, after this edition, is the next thing to read.
